summary: Waste Connections, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the results of its 2026 annual meeting of shareholders held on May 15, 2026. Shareholders elected eight director nominees, approved say-on-pay compensation, and ratified the appointment of Grant Thornton LLP as auditor. This is a routine current report of shareholder votes and contains no event constituting a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other structural change. The filing is purely administrative and does not involve any deal terms or strategic corporate action.
